title: An Efficient Hybrid Heuristic for the Transmission Expansion Planning under Uncertainty
summary: We address the stochastic transmission expansion planning (STEP) problem under uncertainty in renewable generation capacity and demand. STEP's objective is to minimize total transmission investment and generation costs. To tackle the computational challenges posed by large-scale systems, we propose a heuristic strategy that combines the progressive hedging (PH) algorithm for scenario-wise decomposition with an integrated approach for solving the resulting subproblems.
